translation: If indeed sudden coolness binds the exterior with fever, phlegm, and cough, one may only use Congchi Tang, or use Su Geng, Qianhu, Xingren, Zhi, and Jie for just one or two doses.
Moreover, crude workers know it is heat disease yet add Qin and Lian to Xie Bai San, not knowing that more bitterness assists dryness and will certainly increase other transformations.
One should use acrid-cool, sweet-moistening formulas, and the dryness of the qi will level by itself and heal. Be careful not to rob and scorch the stomach fluids with bitter-drying.
